recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量淋巴球，但細胞比典型 CLL 大、細胞質較豐富淡藍，核形不規則、有凹陷或切跡，上方還有破碎的 smudge cell；這種「非典型 CLL 形態」常與第 12 號染色體三體（trisomy 12）相關。
features: Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm, larger than classic CLL cells
Irregular, notched and focally cleaved nuclear contours
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Smudge (basket) cells present at the top of the field
Normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis. The lymphocytes are small to medium sized, with more abundant pale cytoplasm than typical CLL cells, irregular to notched nuclear outlines, and moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; smudge cells are present. Prolymphocytes are not conspicuous in this field. The findings represent atypical CLL morphology, which is associated with trisomy 12, and require immunophenotypic confirmation (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg).

ddx.vs: MCL cells also have irregular or cleaved nuclei but are CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and carry t(11;14), which flow cytometry and FISH resolve.
SMZL cells often have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are typically CD5-negative and CD23-negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus, which is not a feature of most cells here.
